💗 For Milli

A little page made with a very big feeling 💌

Meri Milli,mujhse naraz ho? ♡

Pata hai, shayad mujhse kuch galat hua hai…
aur mujhe yeh bhi pata hai ke tum gussa ho.
Bas please, ek baar meri baat sun lo. 💗

Ek choti si dil ki baat… 💌

Milli, mujhe nahi pata ke main apni baat kitni achi tarah keh paunga, lekin itna zaroor hai ke tum mere liye bohat special ho. Agar meri kisi baat ya harkat se tumhara dil dukha hai, toh I’m genuinely sorry.

Main tumhari feelings ko lightly nahi lena chahta. Tumhara naraz hona bhi mere liye important hai, kyun ke tum important ho. Main tum par foran maaf karne ka pressure nahi dalunga — bas ek chance chahta hoon ke tumhari baat sun sakoon aur apni ghalti sudhaar sakoon.

Will you forgive me, Milli? 🥺

Koi jaldi nahi, Milli. Tumhari feelings aur tumhara waqt dono important hain. ♡

Mera promise tumse 🌷

Main sirf “sorry” keh kar baat khatam nahi karna chahta. Main koshish karunga ke apne actions se bhi tumhein dikha sakoon ke tumhari feelings ki qadar karta hoon. Jab tum ready ho, main tumhari baat sunne ke liye yahin hoon.

No matter what… you matter to me, Milli. ♡

Made with care, just for you, Milli 💗
